title: 第36章 往事如血第37章 缘定心中
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
赵宇看着南宫秋月躺下，来到山洞口，把小五的阵盘安在洞口，以免晚上两人睡着了有妖兽闯入。
他回到了南宫秋月旁边，隔了一段距离坐着了下来。
这一天一夜不知不觉中赵宇的人生发生了巨大的改变，他本是一个不到十五岁的懵懂少年，因为碰到了身负重伤的南宫秋月，他用他的直觉、纯良毫不犹豫地救了南宫秋月。
他心无旁杂：就是要救治那个女孩，他也在不知不觉中从少年蜕变一个有责任心有担当的青年。
看到重伤中毒且濒死的南宫秋月，内心就是一个执念，就是要保护那个女孩，不管认不认识，不管结果如何，也不管是祸是福！
尽管南宫秋月年纪比他大，境界比他高，还高了不少。
他沉思一会，静下心来，开始修炼起“太清正元诀”
中的静心篇，也可能是这两天真的很累了，他不知不觉中睡了过去。
也不知过了多长时间，赵宇感觉到手臂有些酸麻，自然地想翻个身动动身体，可那手臂却翻不起来，感觉是被什么东西压住了。
睁开眼睛一看，原来是南宫秋月的头正枕在他的手臂上，南宫秋月就躺在他身边，两人虽隔了一些距离，也不知道这小丫头什么时候过来的？也不知道怎么过来的？
他静静地看着正睡得一脸香甜的南宫秋月，一副无姤无葭，憨态可爱，纯洁甜美的样子，赵宇有些呆痴了！
他很想上去亲一下南宫秋月红扑扑的脸蛋，随后又骂了自己一句！
转头朝洞口处看了看，见到白光了，应该是天亮了。
赵宇轻轻地抽出了手臂，摔了摔，又轻柔地来到外面，果然天已亮了，他赵忙拿出那只三足铜炉，运起灵火把锅内的药渣焚烧一空，又到旁砍了一枝很大的大笆树，破开大笆树的外皮，把里边藏着的汁水倒入铜炉中，开始点着柴火放在铜炉底下。
他又开始清理熊掌上面的兽毛，把蹄子上的那层硬甲也绞了下来，清理干净放到了炉中，由于熊掌太大，一锅只能放一只，心想还不知道够不够里边那小吃货吃的。
由于火势猛烈，一会儿汤水就沸腾了，一股肉香味直飘四方，赵宇又拿出一些药材和调味品，准备炖一锅十全大补汤。
说起那些调味品也是华服公子那帮人留下的，他现在已知道那帮人是来自一个曹姓的家族，因为他在那堆杂物中发现一块令牌，上面刻有一个曹字，这曹字大摡率不会是什么宗门，应该是一个家族姓氏。
就在此时，他感到身后有沙沙的声音，回头一看是南宫秋月，南宫秋月虽走得不利索，但可以慢慢走了，看来他炼制的疗伤药效果极好。
两人四目对视一会，南宫秋月有些害羞避开目光，轻轻问道：“赵宇，你一大早在忙什么？”
赵宇忙上前两步扶住了南宫秋月，关心问道：“秋月，你出来干嘛？你的伤还没好呢，”

南宫秋月回道：“我感觉好多了，伤口也不怎么痛了，你的药真的太好了，”
指一下那只炉，又问了一遍：“你到底在干嘛？”
赵宇“嘿嘿”
一笑，突然来了一句：“我在熬汤，一会我要喂一头小猪，不然它饿了。”
“小猪，哪有？”
南宫秋月四处张望好几遍，哪有什么小猪，她看了看一边在偷着乐的赵宇，突然明白过来，原来赵宇所指的小猪就是她，她也想不到这个一直有些害羞的小男孩竟敢打趣她！
南宫秋月一跺脚，故作生气说道：“我可不是小猪，你才是！”
content_en:
Zhao Yu watched Nangong Qiuyue lie down, came to the entrance of the cave, and placed Xiao Wu's array plate at the entrance of the cave to prevent monsters from intruding while the two were asleep at night.
He returned to Nangong Qiuyue and sat down at a distance.
Unknowingly, Zhao Yu's life changed dramatically on this day and night. He was originally an ignorant boy under fifteen years old, but because he met Nangong Qiuyue who was seriously injured, he used his intuition and kindness to save Nangong Qiuyue without hesitation.
He had nothing else on his mind: just to save the girl, he unknowingly transformed from a boy into a responsible and responsible young man.
Seeing Nangong Qiuyue, who was seriously injured, poisoned and on the verge of death, she felt an obsession in her heart, which was to protect that girl, no matter whether she knew her or not, no matter what the outcome was, no matter if it was a disaster or a blessing!
Although Nangong Qiuyue is older than him and has a higher level than him, much higher.
He meditated for a while, calmed down, and began to practice the "Tai Qing Zheng Yuan Jue"
In the meditation chapter, it may be that he was really tired for the past two days and he fell asleep unknowingly.
I don't know how long it took, but Zhao Yu felt a little sore and numb in his arm. He naturally wanted to turn over and move his body, but the arm couldn't be turned up. It felt like it was being suppressed by something.
When he opened his eyes, he saw that Nangong Qiuyue's head was resting on his arm, and Nangong Qiuyue was lying next to him. Although there was some distance between the two of them, he didn't know when this little girl came over? Don’t know how you got here?
He quietly looked at Nangong Qiuyue, who was sleeping soundly, looking naive, cute, pure and sweet. Zhao Yu was a little stupid!
He wanted to go up and kiss Nangong Qiuyue's red face, and then cursed himself!
Turning around and looking towards the entrance of the cave, I saw white light, it must be dawn.
Zhao Yu gently pulled out his arm, threw it, and then came outside gently. Sure enough, it was already dawn. Zhao hurriedly took out the three-legged copper stove, used the spiritual fire to burn all the medicine residue in the pot, and then went to the side to cut down a large tree. Breaking the bark of the tree, he poured the juice hidden inside into the copper stove, started to light firewood and put it under the copper stove.
He started cleaning the animal hair on the bear's paws again, and twisted off the layer of hard armor on the hooves. He cleaned it and put it in the stove. Because the bear's paws were so big, only one could be put in a pot, and he didn't know if it would be enough for the snack food inside.
Due to the fierce fire, the soup boiled in a while, and the smell of meat wafted in all directions. Zhao Yu took out some medicinal materials and condiments and prepared to stew a pot of Shiquan Dabu soup.
Speaking of those condiments, they were also left by the Huafu Gongzi group. He now knew that those people came from a family named Cao, because he found a token among the pile of debris with the character Cao engraved on it. This character Cao could not be from any sect, but should be a family name.
At this moment, he felt a rustling sound behind him. When he turned around, he saw that it was Nangong Qiuyue. Although Nangong Qiuyue was not walking well, he could walk slowly. It seemed that the healing medicine he refined was very effective.
The two looked at each other for a while. Nangong Qiuyue was shy and avoided looking, and asked softly: "Zhao Yu, what are you busy with so early in the morning?"
Zhao Yu hurriedly took two steps forward to support Nangong Qiuyue, and asked with concern: "Qiuyue, what are you doing out here? Your injury is not healed yet,"
Nangong Qiuyue replied: "I feel much better, and the wound doesn't hurt much anymore. Your medicine is really good,"
Pointing to the stove, he asked again: "What on earth are you doing?"
Zhao Yu "Hey hey"
Smiling, he suddenly said: "I'm making soup, and I'm going to feed a little pig later, otherwise it will get hungry."
"Little pig, where can I find it?"
Nangong Qiuyue looked around several times, but there was no piggy. She looked at Zhao Yu who was enjoying himself, and suddenly realized that the piggy Zhao Yu was referring to was her. She never expected that this little piggy who had always been shy was her.How dare the little boy tease her!
Nangong Qiuyue stamped her foot, pretending to be angry and said: "I'm not a little pig, you are!"
